scheme_name: Scheme For Loan And Advances to the Beneficiary For Construction Of House
other_conditions: The worker must be a registered active BOC worker under the Tripura Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
The worker must have been a registered construction worker for at least 5 years
The worker should have at least 20 years remaining before retirement
The worker must not own any pucca house in any part of the country
The worker should have a minimum land area of 30 square metres as per their income status for house construction
The beneficiary family should not have availed any central assistance under any housing scheme from the central or state government
benefits_summary: Provides a credit‑linked interest subsidy of 6.5 % on loans up to ₹6 lakh, repayable over a maximum period of 20 years.
